Five 1024^2 maps (BaseColor, Normal DirectX green-down, MRE, StateMask, AtlasDebug) baked from the v3 atlas by ebs_texbake.py, 722/722 charts painted, deterministic, independently verified against the bake manifest (no blocking or major defects; eight minor defects recorded for the ART_ALPHA bake). Not yet: Material instances, in-engine textured capture, 2048^2 stack, gate reviews, owner acceptance.

Concept rework to the candidate proportions: octagonal tower 780 cm at W 200 (3.9 W, measured on the candidate pixels), single load collar at 0.72 H, four near-square numbered panels, two-step plinth with outboard couplings, Ø 0.16 W segmented conduit stubs; re-baked 1024^2 maps on the new atlas; 42 tests; comparison sheets 01-09 against concepts A/B and the candidate; two independent verification lenses (fidelity, rules) and a fix pass; headless import run 10: 3 meshes, all checks pass. Not yet: Hanging-conduit part (OWNER-QUESTION OQ-2), owner ruling on the pixel-measured proportion amendment (OQ-1), textures rebake at 2048^2, in-engine capture, gates, owner acceptance.

packages.subject: Lancer
packages.canon_status: CANDIDATE (EBS-CON-MER-UNT-002 (REPLACE; the lancer-candidate sheet and its derived turnaround are the direction)); not owner acceptance

stage_receipts.result: Braced two-legged line-fire frame built to the candidate: hip-mounted rail-lance with a full-length cyan channel, low sensor cowl between two shoulder pods, exposed charcoal flanks, slim rear-leg recoil strut with a sliding gland. 18-bone rig with the card's lance_yaw/lance_barrel sub-objects and sockets Muzzle_Flash_01, Target_Anchor_Center, Left_Tread_Vector; 9 clips including the halt-plant-aim-fire-recover sequence. LOD0 1,828 / LOD1 968 tris against 8,000 / 3,500. 27 tests, 13 comparison sheets, two verification lenses and a fix pass. Import: 0 errors, 18 AnimSequences, 3 sockets.

Owner ruling implemented (concept-v4): Rear_Recoil_Strut_Anchor added at the strut's upper clevis where recoil enters the frame, Left_Tread_Vector kept at the identical transform as a temporary compatibility alias, and Foot_Contact_L/R added at the soles so ground contact has its own name. LOD1 ceiling confirmed at 3,500 per REL-ART-028. Geometry unchanged; 34 tests; import 0 errors, 18 AnimSequences, 6 sockets.

packages.next: Textures (2048^2), emissive measurement, in-engine playback, gates. The compatibility alias is dropped when the adapter migration is tested.

packages.subject: Bulwark Team
packages.canon_status: CANDIDATE (EBS-CON-MER-UNT-003 (KEEP) with the owner-corrected six-cell derived reference); not owner acceptance

stage_receipts.result: Wide two-operator chassis on four legs with six hinged barrier cells, three per wing, deploying into one flat frontal face 499 cm across with the 03/04 seam on the operator centreline and the emitter beneath it. Every cell carries an opaque back plate so the rear read is geometry, not a material promise (verified by a depth-sorted visibility census: 0.0% barrier field frontmost from behind). Both wings export as the card's Left_Shield_Panel / Right_Shield_Panel sub-objects. 18-bone rig, 10 clips, LOD0 3,618 / LOD1 1,846 against 8,200 / 3,600. 64 tests, 15 sheets, two lenses and a fix pass. Import: 0 errors, 20 AnimSequences, 9 sockets.

Owner ruling implemented (concept-v5): the barrier field slabs, cyan rims and opaque back plates moved into SK_EBS_MER_UNT_003_Barrier_Panes, a separately controlled skinned sub-object on the same 18-bone skeleton, so the packed silhouette loses the barrier while the chassis, wings and six structural frames stay present. Whole unit unchanged at LOD0 3,618 / LOD1 1,846 (main 2,898 + panes 720 / 1,126 + 720); 81 tests; import 0 errors, 40 AnimSequences across the unit and the sub-object.

packages.next: Integration owns the visibility contract: the pane assembly follows authoritative deployment state including cancellation and save restoration. Then textures, in-engine playback, gates.

rulings.subject: EBS-MER-UNT-002 Lancer sockets
rulings.question: The card names Left_Tread_Vector on a frame that walks on legs
rulings.ruling: The recorded Lancer decision specifies Rear_Recoil_Strut_Anchor, with Left_Tread_Vector retained temporarily as a compatibility alias. Left-foot ground contact is a different function and needs its own separately named foot-contact socket if required. Preserve the two-legged concept.

rulings.subject: EBS-MER-UNT-003 Bulwark barrier
rulings.question: How the barrier leaves the packed silhouette (OWNER-QUESTION F)
rulings.ruling: Third, separately controlled barrier sub-object. Chassis, hinged wings and six structural frames stay physically present, three panes from each side, centred when deployed. The field slabs and the removable pane assembly are separated so they disappear while packed. The component contract is updated explicitly. Visibility follows authoritative deployment state including cancellation and save restoration. The added component does not increase the whole-unit triangle budget.

rulings.subject: EBS-MER-UNT-004 Relay Skiff weapon
rulings.question: The novel says the skiff could not fight; the requirements give it a weapon
rulings.ruling: Keep the weapon. Game requirements govern the game asset: retain the small forward emitter and its attack animation while the mast, dish and archive cradle stay dominant. The book difference is recorded as a cross-media difference; it does not block model production or authorise removing the game's weapon.
